fusions.name: Link Skip
fusions.desc: Flicks a weighted link that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Run Rings
fusions.desc: Runs a loop of links round everything near you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tripline
fusions.desc: Lays a line of links 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 25% for 3 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Slack Taken Up
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, 8 stamina comes back to you. Once every 6 seconds.
